title: David Returns to Jerusalem
description: After Absalom's death, Joab persuades King David to stop mourning and show himself to the people. David returns toward Jerusalem and crosses the Jordan. Shimei throws himself down and begs for forgiveness, and David promises that he will not die. Mephibosheth explains why he did not follow the king, and Barzillai from Gilead accompanies the king part of the way before declining to go further and sending Kimham in his place. Finally, a dispute arises between the men of Judah and the men of Israel over who has the greater right to the king.
